title: A plan that costs more
hook: Two stated cases: explore equal stated benefits with unequal costs.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How equal stated benefits with unequal costs affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines NetGap, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare equal stated benefits with unequal costs in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
